verdict.line: You lose if you let him stack three bites of An Acquired Taste and get tongue-stunned into a kill, you win if you poke his approach down and starve his sustain.

brief.thesis: Tahm Kench's entire kill threat is built on landing three stacks of An Acquired Taste then locking you with Q (Tongue Lash) for the stun, and his Q is a 900-range skillshot he has to land while your Q (Blinding Dart) is an 8-second-cooldown blind that shuts off his autos entirely. This is why Teemo sits at 51.1% over 182 games despite OP.GG calling the matchup lane-advantage Tahm Kench: you have the tools to deny his stacking, but he out-sustains and out-trades you if you ever stand in auto range.

tell.watch: his An Acquired Taste stack count

theirWindow.when: he's at 3 stacks, E (Thick Skin) up
theirWindow.what: He can land Q (Tongue Lash) for a full stun and follow with autos while shielded by stored damage. Back off the moment you see 3 stacks — do not trade through a stun window.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Tongue Lash) and W (Abyssal Dive) both down
yourWindow.what: He has no poke, no engage, and no gap-close for 5-7s on Q and 17-21s on W. Walk up and free-hit with E (Toxic Shot) autos, since he can't punish the approach.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Run at 70.2% pick and 48.8% win over 172 games — the mana and AP sustain lets you throw E (Toxic Shot) poke stacks without running dry against his healing.

boots.why: 61.4% win over 114 games — the flat move speed matters more here than magic pen since you need to kite out of his melee range and dodge Q (Tongue Lash) before he reaches 3 stacks.

core.why: On-hit autos poke him down without entering melee, and the proc clears waves so you can shove him off CS while he's stuck healing.
Burn damage punishes his high HP pool directly — his passive scales off total health, so sustained DoT is the most efficient way through it.
The 64.8% win rate path over 54 games; the extra burst window lets your R (Noxious Trap) zone and poke finish fights before his E (Thick Skin) shield absorbs it all.

you need tempo to reset between his cooldown windows

runes.keystoneWhy: The 54.5% page's 26.4% pick rate — three autos mark him for bonus damage, which punishes every short trade window he opens to try to land a Q (Tongue Lash) stack.

summoners.why: 86.9% pick rate at 50.5% win — Ignite's DoT denies his E (Thick Skin) healing exactly when he tries to sustain through your poke, and Flash lets you dodge his W (Abyssal Dive) knockup engage.

playing.title: Blind before he swings
playing.detail: Use Q (Blinding Dart) the instant he walks up for an auto — the 8s cooldown means you can reliably deny one attack per engage, which is the single biggest lever against his stacking passive.

playing.title: Never trade at 3 stacks
playing.detail: The moment his An Acquired Taste hits 3, his next Q (Tongue Lash) stuns instead of just slowing. Disengage immediately rather than contesting CS.

playing.title: Poke, don't duel
playing.detail: Stay at your 680-range Q/E threat and let Statikk Shiv procs do the work — standing in his melee range to trade autos is exactly what his passive and healing are built to win.

playing.title: Punish his cooldown gaps
playing.detail: Q (Tongue Lash) is only 5-7s and W (Abyssal Dive) is 17-21s — after he whiffs or uses either, you have a clean window to walk up and free-hit before he can threaten again.

playing.title: Trap the wave, not his feet
playing.detail: R (Noxious Trap) has only a 1s cooldown per mushroom but 230 range, so lay them in brush and on the wave to zone his approach rather than trying to land them directly on him.

playing.title: Don't feed R (Devour) targets
playing.detail: If he ever gets 3 stacks on you specifically, he can swallow you outright — if you're already low, disengage well before stacks cap rather than gambling a trade.

playing.title: Use invisibility to reset, not to fight
playing.detail: Camouflage lets you heal up off his poke and come back with the Element of Surprise attack speed burst — use it to re-enter trades on your terms, not to force an all-in he's built to win.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoners here are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the stack-denial reasoning and trade-window timing are my own read of the kit, not scraped data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Tahm Kench from gaining three stacks of An Acquired Taste (P)! Use Blinding Dart [Q] to block his basic attacks and prevent him from stacking up An Acquired Taste (P).
